metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2024 · Blue Box
metas.description: Third-year student Taiki joins badminton club. Despite being an early riser, star player Chinatsu, his crush, arrives first. Living together unexpectedly, Taiki strives to reach Nationals to impress Chinatsu.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2024 · Ataturk 1881-1919
metas.description: The early life story of Veteran Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, the founding father of the Republic of Turkey and its first President, supreme commander of Turkish War of Independence, and revolutionary statesman.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2024 · Are You Sure?!
metas.description: Whenever BTS's Jimin and Jung Kook meet, chaos and excitement ensue! In the summer of 2023, they embark on an unforgettable trip before their military enlistment. Their unpredictable adventure is full of surprises. Will Jimin and Jung Kook complete their journey safely?

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Witch Hat Atelier
metas.description: The series follows a girl named Coco, who dreams of being a witch, but in her world only those born with magical abilities are able to become witches. However, after meeting a witch named Qifrey, Coco's dream begins to come true.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · Small Prophets
metas.description: Eccentric Michael Sleep, whose darling partner, Clea, disappeared seven years ago, sets out to create Homunculi - magical prophesying spirits that can predict the future.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · Gassal
metas.description: A Turkish mortician in his 30s, Baki is an introverted man content with his isolation from society. However, when he comes up against death at close range, a troubling question strikes him: who would wash his body after he dies? This realization pushes him to venture out into the world, hoping to connect with people and perhaps even find a spouse. Yet, his life-changing decision proves difficult to go through with, leading to a series of awkwardly humorous and sometimes bizarre situations.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2024 · The On1y One
metas.description: When their parents marry, two high school students become stepbrothers and navigate their relationship, turning from enemies into something more special.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · Gyaarah Gyaarah
metas.description: Investigative drama following events in 1990, 2001, 2016. Intertwining storylines blending mysticism, science and mystery across the decades.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2025 · Top Form
metas.description: Akin, a veteran actor and five-time "Sexiest Man of the Year," loses his title to rising star Jin, who secretly admires and loves him despite the rivalry.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2025 · Bhay: The Gaurav Tiwari Mystery
metas.description: Gaurav Tiwari, a paranormal investigator, faces his greatest challenge when his pursuit of the truth behind unexplained phenomena leads him into a deadly spiral. As his mysterious death leaves questions unanswered, a journalist delves into his eerie and celebrated legacy, unearthing secrets that blur the line between reality and the supernatural.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2025 · Study Group
metas.description: A struggling student at Korea's worst high school forms a study group while protecting his classmates with his fighting skills, hoping to overcome academic challenges and secure a spot in college.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2026 · Operation Safed Sagar
metas.description: As the Kargil War erupts between India and Pakistan, the Golden Arrows squadron of the Air Force takes flight on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2024 · Orb: On the Movements of the Earth
metas.description: After learning heretical teachings about the Earth and the Sun, a child prodigy searches for his master's hidden research while evading the Inquisition.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2025 · The Savage
metas.description: Are you a slave or a worker?!

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Outlander: Blood of My Blood
metas.description: This prequel to the Outlander series focuses on the lives and courtship of the parents of Jamie Fraser: Brian Fraser and Ellen Mackenzie as well as Claire Beauchamp's parents, Henry Beauchamp and Julia Moriston.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · Tip Toe
metas.description: Neighbors Leo, a Canal Street bar owner, and Clive, an electrician with teen sons, find their lives unraveling as social tensions rise. Simple disagreements escalate into dangerous hostility in their Manchester suburb.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
metas.description: A relaxed principal tries to reform a failing public school, triggering a messy transformation as misfit teachers work to repair the system one lesson at a time.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2024 · 90's - A Middle Class Biopic
metas.description: A nostalgic trip down memory lane, delving into the everyday life of a middle-class family.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2024 · Turning Point: The Bomb and the Cold War
metas.description: The series chronicles the creation of the atomic bomb and the spread of nuclear arms over the following decades. It continues past the dissolution of the Soviet Union to Vladimir Putin's ascent and the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Last One Laughing: UK
metas.description: Ten top UK comedians face off in Jimmy Carr's challenge: make others laugh while keeping a straight face. They'll try everything to crack their opponents, but must never break themselves.

metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 2026 · Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
metas.description: Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. The Kais and Supreme...

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Win or Lose
metas.description: Follows a middle school softball team in the week leading up to their championship game, and each episode is told from the perspective of a different character.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2024 · Conan O'Brien Must Go
metas.description: After years of conversations with listeners from across the world on his podcast Conan O'Brien Needs a Friend (2018), Conan O'Brien sets off on an epic journey to connect with some of his dedicated followers in person.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2026 · VisionQuest
metas.description: Vision is faced with many challenges while trying to regain his memory and humanity.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2026 · Pursuit of Jade
metas.description: Changyu Fan and Zheng Xie enter a fake marriage for separate reasons, but their love grows. Separated by conflict, they reunite on the battlefield, fighting together for justice, truth, and their love.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2024 · India's Got Latent
metas.description: Samay Raina and the guest judges hilariously critique the untapped, undeniably entertaining "latent" talents of aspiring performers, testing their self-awareness with a unique scoring system.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2024 · Mussolini: Son of the Century
metas.description: Benito Mussolini's early career from his founding of the Fasci Italiani in 1919 up to the assassination of socialist politician Giacomo Matteotti in 1924 and his speech in Parliament on 3 January 1925.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2025 · Riot Women
metas.description: Follows a group of middle-aged women, as they form a punk-rock band to participate in a talent contest.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2026 · Rafa
metas.description: Delves into Rafael Nadal's illustrious tennis career, offering a behind-the-scenes look at his personal life, unseen archives, and his journey to return to competitive play in 2024 after overcoming injuries in 2023.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2024 · Culinary Class Wars
metas.description: Pits 100 renowned chefs and undiscovered talents against each other in a culinary battle. Judged by the esteemed Paik Jong-won and Chef Anh Sung-jae, the show promises to showcase the ultimate clash of culinary skills and creativity.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Resident Playbook
metas.description: First-year OBGYN residents at Yulje Medical Center navigate the chaos of their work and personal lives, all in their quest to become exceptional doctors.

metas.name: ★ 8.9 · 2024 · Kabhi Main Kabhi Tum
metas.description: Opposites attract with the love story between a bibliophile, topper and a sorted girl with a practical approach and a laid-back guy.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2026 · Family Kirana Store
metas.description: A middle-class small-town family's father obsesses over his struggling grocery store attached to their home. He fights to attract customers while facing robberies, counterfeit money, and other threats.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2025 · Revenged Love
metas.description: After Wu Suo-wei's girlfriend dumps him, he decides to get revenge by seducing her new boyfriend, Chi Cheng! It started as a game, but falling in love was never part of the plan.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · I Became My CEO's Darkest Secret
★ 8.8 · 2025 · Kurukshetra
metas.description: An epic 18-day battle unfolds through the perspectives of 18 warriors, revealing their inner struggles and ethical challenges during a war between brothers.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2025 · Pee-wee as Himself
metas.description: A kaleidoscopic portrait told in two parts that traces the life of the imaginative artist.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2025 · The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
metas.description: In Elmore, reality bends and family life gets weird. Gumball pulls Darwin, Anais, and the whole town into adventures - from fighting evil fast food to dealing with an AI crushing on his mom. The show's so wild, it needed a new name.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2025 · The First Frost
metas.description: Wen Yifan, a reporter, meets Sang Yan, her former high school crush at a bar. Initially pretending not to recognize each other, circumstances lead them to become housemates. They rekindle their love and reconcile the relationship.
